messages.content: I forgot my online password — how do I reset it?

response:
To reset your online banking password, please follow these steps:

1. Visit the AtlasBank official website.
2. Click on the "Login" button located at the top right corner of the homepage.
3. On the login page, click on the "Forgot Password" link below the login fields.
4. You will be asked to provide your account number and email address associated with your account. Once you've entered these details, click on the "Submit" button.
5. Follow the instructions provided in the email sent to your registered email address to reset your password.
6. If you encounter any issues during this process, please feel free to contact our customer service for further assistance.
